purpose: Falsify whether work-aware per-tile gradient value can beat gradient/error blind policies at matched REAL renderer cost before implementing new CUDA

source_reference_only.role: code inspection lead; MX source and .so identity must be separately verified

primary_loss_for_unbiased_theory: per-pixel additive L1; strictly separated from non-additive DSSIM/LPIPS
primary_parameter_group: geometry: means3d plus scales/quats, with predeclared group normalization

arms.U: uniform independent Bernoulli tile inclusion, HT loss
arms.E: error-proxy guided Bernoulli tile inclusion, equal expected real GPU budget, HT loss
arms.T: temporal complementary Bernoulli/cyclic policy if existing, diagnostic only
arms.O: offline inaccessible per-tile gradient oracle; upper bound only, never timed as deployable policy
arms.P: cheap past-only gradient-value/cost proxy, prospective test on held-out TRAIN states/cameras

sampling.selection: independent Bernoulli per candidate tile for mathematical oracle
sampling.loss: HT weighted pixel sums divided by exactly total training-view pixel/channel count
sampling.rule: never substitute selected-pixel mean for unequal inclusion probabilities
sampling.border_tiles: weight actual valid pixels; never count padded pixels

next_stage: Only after both oracle and deployable proxy gates pass, request a separately frozen 3K quality-vs-wall pilot; never automatically start 30K
source_and_evidence_rules: Use only genuine pre-existing MX checkpoints, record state path SHA256, N, iteration and provenance; block if missing
Source identity includes git SHA, dirty diff SHA, .so path SHA256, dataset and camera manifests
No synthetic Gaussians as real workload; synthetic only for standalone unit tests
No held-out/test views or pixels for policy design, tuning or scores
No CUDA kernel rewrite, no optimizer/densification/loss schedule alteration
Do not infer additive GPU time from tile-level proxy costs; measure actual mask-set CUDA and wall time
Do not claim non-additive loss unbiasedness
Do not equate an offline optimal policy (requiring true gradients) with deployable training speed
Preserve raw logs and mark absent experiments NOT_RUN / BLOCKED
No killing other GPU users or deleting scientific data
